stewardship merge judge
journal / disk-health / typed-OODA actor
overseer merge-queue / ecosystem / smart-orchestrator

span.p:
RecipeBrain::new preconditions:
recipe exists + recipe-runner-rs --version + agent binary resolves

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
(engineer-spawn path only) amplihack_freshness_gate
runs 'amplihack update' pre-spawn src/amplihack_freshness_gate/

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ContextFile (only when a var is large; else inline argv):
large vars -> 0700 temp file, -c key_path=/tmp/... (avoids execve E2BIG)
src/recipe_context_file.rs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Command::new(recipe-runner-rs)
arg(recipe_path) --output-format json
env AMPLIHACK_AGENT_BINARY -c key=value ...
OR: amplihack recipe run smart-orchestrator (overseer)

recipe_output: strip_ansi + strip_recipe_noise
extract_json_payload / extract_verdict
